title: Mike and Geometry Problem
statementMd:
Mike wants to prepare for IMO but he doesn't know geometry, so his teacher gave him an interesting geometry problem. Let's define $*f*([*l*, *r*]) = *r* - *l* + 1$ to be the number of integer points in the segment $[*l*, *r*]$ with $*l* ≤ *r*$ (say that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1615b40d21388b3b07e9da1685903cf7bb98b938.png)). You are given two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ and $*n*$ closed intervals $[*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}]$ on $*OX*$ axis and you have to find:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/445db4f35f9443a2e3b2746a7a86df83be195bb7.png)

In other words, you should find the sum of the number of integer points in the intersection of any $*k*$ of the segments.

As the answer may be very large, output it modulo $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$).

Mike can't solve this problem so he needs your help. You will help him, won't you?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of segments and the number of segments in intersection groups respectively.

Then $*n*$ lines follow, the $*i*$-th line contains two integers $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$ $( - 10^{9} ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$, describing $*i*$-th segment bounds.

## Output

Print one integer number — the answer to Mike's problem modulo $1000000007$ ($10^{9} + 7$) in the only line.

## Note

In the first example:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/099f833590960ffc5dafcbc207172a93605c44a8.png);

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f56e6e99db45efff1c9be404aeb569c7e2bbb1d.png);

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eaff785f85562a9ff263ebbbfafe78a6b2581a57.png).

So the answer is $2 + 1 + 2 = 5$.
statementZhMd:
Mike 想为 IMO 做准备，但他不懂几何，因此他的老师给了他一道有趣的几何题。我们定义 $*f*([*l*, *r*]) = *r* - *l* + 1$，表示在线段 $[*l*, *r*]$（其中 $*l* ≤ *r*$）中的整数点数量（即

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1615b40d21388b3b07e9da1685903cf7bb98b938.png)

）。给定两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$，以及 $*OX*$ 轴上的 $*n*$ 个闭区间 $[*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}]$，你需要求出：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/445db4f35f9443a2e3b2746a7a86df83be195bb7.png)

换句话说，你需要求任意 $*k*$ 个线段的交集中的整数点数量之和。

由于答案可能非常大，请将其对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后输出。

Mike 无法解决这道题，所以他需要你的帮助。你愿意帮助他吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$）——线段的数量，以及交集分组中线段的数量。

接下来 $*n*$ 行，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}$（$ - 10^{9} ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 条线段的端点。

## 输出格式

仅一行输出一个整数——Mike 的问题的答案对 $1000000007$（$10^{9} + 7$）取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/099f833590960ffc5dafcbc207172a93605c44a8.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6f56e6e99db45efff1c9be404aeb569c7e2bbb1d.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/eaff785f85562a9ff263ebbfafe78a6b2581a57.png)

因此答案为 $2 + 1 + 2 = 5$。
